_note: Bot har din is list ka PEHLA app website pe daalta hai (aur yahan se hata deta hai). Naya app add karna ho to isi format mein list ke end mein jodo. Sirf official links!

queue.name: Squoosh
queue.what: Browser me image compress/resize: before-after compare karke size kam karo — upload kahin nahi hota.

queue.name: Money Manager Ex
queue.what: Kharcha aur budget tracker: accounts, categories, reports — offline, no ads.

queue.name: GeoGebra
queue.what: Maths ke liye graphing calculator, geometry, 3D, CAS — equations ka graph turant.

queue.name: Read Along by Google
queue.what: Bachchon ke liye reading app: Hindi/English stories zor se padho, AI assistant 'Diya' sunke help karta hai. No ads, offline.

queue.name: My Expenses
queue.what: Expense tracker: cash/bank/card ke accounts, budgets, reports, CSV export.
queue.priceNote: Free core, open source (GPL-3.0); kuch features paid
queue.limit: Kuch features paid (Contrib/Extended).

queue.name: Desmos
queue.what: Free graphing + scientific calculator: equation likho, graph live banta hai — maths/physics samajhne ke liye.

queue.name: OsmAnd
queue.what: Offline maps + navigation: poore state/country ka map download karo, bina net ke raasta dekho. Trekking/hiking ke liye bhi.
queue.priceNote: Free core, open source (GPL-3.0); kuch features paid
queue.limit: Kuch extra features (OsmAnd Pro/Maps+) paid hain.

queue.name: Delta Chat
queue.what: Chat app jo email pe chalta hai: WhatsApp jaisa look, end-to-end encryption, bina phone number.
queue.limit: Dost ke paas bhi Delta Chat hona behtar.

queue.name: PhET Simulations
queue.what: Physics, chemistry, maths ke interactive simulations (University of Colorado) — khud experiment karke concept samjho.

queue.name: SimpleX Chat
queue.what: Messenger jisme na phone number, na user ID: QR/link se connect, end-to-end encrypted.
queue.limit: Dost ko bhi install karna padega.

queue.name: freeCodeCamp
queue.what: Coding free me seekho: web development, JavaScript, Python, data — projects aur free certifications ke saath.
queue.limit: English me hai.

queue.name: Jami
queue.what: Video/voice call aur chat peer-to-peer — koi central server nahi, koi phone number nahi.
queue.limit: Weak network pe calls thodi unstable ho sakti hain.

queue.name: CS50 (Harvard)
queue.what: Harvard ka famous computer science course free online: lectures, problem sets, programming basics se.
queue.priceNote: Free; edX ka verified certificate paid optional
queue.limit: English me; mehnat wala course.

queue.name: Ente Auth
queue.what: 2FA codes app with end-to-end encrypted backup — phone badla to codes safe rehte hain.

queue.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
queue.what: MIT ke hazaron courses ke notes, lectures, assignments free — engineering, maths, CS.
queue.limit: Certificate nahi milta.

queue.name: Ente Photos
queue.what: Photos ka end-to-end encrypted cloud backup, family sharing, Google Photos jaisa.
queue.priceNote: Free plan + paid storage; open source (AGPL-3.0)
queue.limit: Free plan me storage limited; zyada storage paid.

queue.name: PCAPdroid
queue.what: Bina root dekho kaunsi app kis server se baat kar rahi hai; network traffic record karo (PCAP) — networking seekhne walon ke liye mast.
queue.limit: Play Store version me kuch extra features paid unlock hain.

queue.name: SWAYAM
queue.what: Government of India ka free online courses portal: school se PG tak, IIT/IIM professors ke courses.
queue.priceNote: Free courses; certificate exam ki fees lagti hai

queue.name: Photomath
queue.what: Maths question ki photo lo — step-by-step solution aur explanation.
queue.limit: Detailed explanations ka kuch hissa Plus me; copy nahi, samajhne ke liye use karo.

queue.name: Mindustry
queue.what: Factory + tower defense strategy game: conveyor belts se resources, turrets se defence, multiplayer bhi.
queue.limit: Play Store/Steam pe paid hai; F-Droid wala Android version free.

queue.name: National Digital Library of India
queue.what: IIT Kharagpur ki free digital library: books, notes, question papers, videos — school se research tak.

queue.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
queue.what: Pixel-art dungeon game: har baar naya dungeon, items, boss fights. No ads.
queue.limit: Supporter pack optional in-app purchase.

queue.name: Typst
queue.what: LaTeX ka modern, aasaan alternative: assignments, reports, resume — instant preview ke saath.
queue.priceNote: Compiler free, open source (Apache-2.0); web app ke kuch plans paid
queue.limit: LaTeX templates jitne zyada nahi.

queue.name: Simon Tatham's Puzzles
queue.what: 40 se zyada dimaag wale puzzle games ek app me — no ads, offline.

queue.name: Overleaf
queue.what: Browser me LaTeX editor: research papers, project reports, resume — templates ke saath, team me likho.
queue.limit: Free plan me compile time aur collaborators limited.

queue.name: Lichess
queue.what: Chess online/offline: puzzles, lessons, tournaments — hamesha free, koi ads nahi.

queue.name: Luanti (Minetest)
queue.what: Block-building sandbox game: duniya banao, mods aur online servers — Minecraft jaisa, free.
queue.limit: Graphics simple; achha experience mods/games download karne pe.

queue.name: Ollama
queue.what: Apne PC pe AI models (Llama, Gemma, Qwen waghera) offline chalao — ek command se.
queue.limit: Achhi RAM/GPU chahiye; bade models slow chalenge.

queue.name: SuperTuxKart
queue.what: Kart racing game: tracks, karts, online multiplayer — no ads.
queue.limit: Download bada hai.

queue.name: GPT4All
queue.what: Desktop app jo AI chatbot ko tumhare PC pe offline chalata hai; apne documents se chat (LocalDocs).
queue.limit: 8 GB+ RAM recommended; cloud AI jitna smart nahi.

queue.name: Noice
queue.what: Barish, jungle, cafe jaisi awaaze mix karke padhai/focus ya neend ke liye — timer ke saath.
queue.limit: Play Store version me kuch premium sounds paid.

queue.name: LM Studio
queue.what: Easy app jisme AI models download karke PC pe offline chalao — chat window ke saath.
queue.limit: Achhi RAM/GPU chahiye.

queue.name: whoBIRD
queue.what: Pakshi ki awaaz record karo — app offline bata deta hai kaunsa bird hai.
queue.limit: Accuracy awaaz ki quality pe depend.

queue.name: Sololearn
queue.what: Phone pe coding seekho: Python, C++, JavaScript, SQL — chhote lessons + code playground.
queue.limit: Kuch courses/features Pro me; free me ads.

queue.name: NotebookLM
queue.what: Apne notes, PDF, YouTube links daalo — Google ka AI unhi se answers, summary, quiz aur audio overview banata hai.
queue.limit: Free me notebooks aur sources ki limit; Google account chahiye.

queue.name: F-Droid
queue.what: Free aur open-source Android apps ka official store: hazaron apps bina ads/tracking, auto updates.
queue.limit: APK site se download karke install karna padta hai (Play Store pe nahi).

queue.name: Coffee
queue.what: Ek quick-settings tile jo screen ko jagaye rakhta hai — recipe, notes ya PDF padhte waqt screen band nahi hogi.

queue.name: Google AI Studio
queue.what: Gemini models free me try karo aur free API key banao — apne projects/apps me AI lagao.
queue.limit: Free tier me rate limits; free tier ka data Google product improve karne me use ho sakta hai.

queue.name: Survival Manual
queue.what: Offline survival guide: first aid, paani, aag, navigation — bina internet ke kaam ka.
queue.limit: English me hai.

queue.name: Google Colab
queue.what: Browser me Python notebooks, free GPU ke saath — ML/AI seekhne aur chalane ke liye, kuch install nahi.
queue.limit: Free GPU guaranteed nahi; session time-limited.

queue.name: MediLog
queue.what: BP, sugar, weight, temperature ka log aur charts — mummy-papa ke health record ke liye, data phone pe.
queue.limit: Doctor ki salah ka badla nahi.

queue.name: Kaggle
queue.what: Data science seekho: free notebooks + GPU, datasets, competitions, free mini courses.
queue.limit: GPU ka weekly quota limited.

queue.name: LibreSudoku
queue.what: Sudoku game bina ads: alag difficulty, hints, notes mode.

queue.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
queue.what: College/school students ke liye free developer tools ka bundle: GitHub Copilot, domains, cloud credits waghera.
queue.limit: Student ID/college email se verification chahiye; offers time ke saath badalte hain.

queue.name: ConnectBot
queue.what: Phone se SSH: server, Raspberry Pi ya cloud machine ko terminal se chalao.
queue.limit: Technical users ke liye.

queue.name: Screenshot Tile
queue.what: Quick settings tile ya floating button se screenshot — bina root, partial screenshot bhi.

queue.name: Freesound
queue.what: Lakhon free sound effects ka library — videos, games, podcasts ke liye.
queue.priceNote: Free (har sound ka Creative Commons license alag)
queue.limit: Har sound ka license (CC0 / CC-BY) check karo; download ke liye account.

queue.name: Acode
queue.what: Phone pe code editor: HTML, CSS, JS, Python waghera, GitHub, plugins aur terminal.
queue.limit: Kuch features/plugins paid; free version me ads ho sakte hain.

queue.name: Google Fonts
queue.what: 1,000+ free fonts — thumbnails, posters, websites me commercial use bhi free.

queue.name: Total Commander
queue.what: Powerful file manager: do-panel view, ZIP, FTP/LAN plugins, root — bilkul free, no ads.
queue.limit: Look purana-sa; open source nahi.

queue.name: OCR (Text Scanner)
queue.what: Photo se text nikalo (OCR) — offline, Hindi samet kai languages (Tesseract).
queue.limit: Language data alag download; haath ki likhawat kam pakadta hai.

queue.name: Ezgif
queue.what: Browser me GIF banao, video ko GIF, crop/resize/compress — sab free online.
queue.limit: File size limit; site pe ads.

queue.name: CPU Info
queue.what: Phone ka poora hardware info: processor, RAM, battery, sensors, display — naya/second-hand phone check karne ke liye.

queue.name: Hail
queue.what: Faltu ya background me chalne wali apps ko freeze karo, zarurat pe ek tap se wapas.
queue.limit: Shizuku/root/device owner jaisa setup chahiye.

queue.name: LMMS
queue.what: Music banao PC pe: beats, melodies, samples, VST plugins — music production free me.
queue.limit: FL Studio jaisa polish nahi.

queue.name: SMS Import / Export
queue.what: SMS, MMS aur call logs ka backup file me — naye phone me wapas import.

queue.name: MuseScore Studio
queue.what: Music notation software: sheet music likho, playback suno, PDF/MIDI export.
queue.priceNote: Free, open source (GPL-3.0); musescore.com Pro alag paid

queue.name: Translate You
queue.what: Translator jo kai free engines (LibreTranslate, Lingva waghera) use karta hai — bina tracking.

queue.name: Stellarium
queue.what: Computer pe planetarium: aaj raat aasmaan me kaunse taare, planets, constellation dikhenge.
queue.limit: Mobile wala Stellarium app alag hai (uske kuch features paid).

queue.name: PPSSPP
queue.what: PSP games phone/PC pe khelo, HD graphics ke saath. Gold version paid hai, free version me bhi poora emulator.
queue.limit: Games (ISO) ki apni legal copy honi chahiye.

queue.name: KeePassXC
queue.what: PC ka offline password manager: ek master password, saare passwords encrypted file me.
queue.limit: Sync khud karna padta hai (Drive/Syncthing).

queue.name: Transistor
queue.what: Simple internet radio app: duniya bhar ke radio stations search karke suno.

queue.name: Paperize
queue.what: Wallpaper changer: apni photos ka folder do, time ke hisaab se wallpaper khud badlega.

queue.name: VeraCrypt
queue.what: Pendrive ya folder ko password-locked encrypted drive bana do — laptop chori ho to bhi data safe.
queue.limit: Password bhool gaye to data wapas nahi milega.

queue.name: UMANG
queue.what: Ek app me 1,000+ government services: EPFO, scholarship, DigiLocker, gas booking, exam results waghera.

queue.name: Bubble
queue.what: Spirit level + ruler: shelf/photo frame seedha lagana ho to phone hi level ban jata hai.

queue.name: Tor Browser
queue.what: Privacy browser jo traffic ko Tor network se ghuma ke IP chhupata hai.
queue.limit: Normal browser se slow; kuch sites block karti hain.

queue.name: Moonlight Game Streaming
queue.what: PC ke games phone pe stream karke khelo (NVIDIA GameStream/Sunshine), ghar ke Wi-Fi pe.
queue.limit: Gaming PC chahiye aur strong Wi-Fi.

queue.name: tldraw
queue.what: Infinite whiteboard browser me: diagrams, sketch, dosto ke saath live collaboration.
queue.limit: Account ke bina files sirf browser me save.

queue.name: Canta
queue.what: Phone ki faltu pre-installed (bloatware) apps bina root hatao — Shizuku ke saath.
queue.limit: Galat system app hata di to dikkat; recommendations padh ke hatao.

queue.name: remove.bg
queue.what: Photo ka background 5 second me hatao — thumbnails aur product photos ke liye.
queue.limit: Free download low-resolution; HD ke liye credits.

queue.name: Notesnook
queue.what: End-to-end encrypted notes app: notebooks, tags, sync sab devices pe.
queue.limit: Kuch features paid plan me.
